chapter: Split, hospital and decline of tap
title: Baby Rosemarie and Nipsy Russell the dancing chauffeur
summary: Green names Baby Rosemarie as a leading female tapper and Nipsy Russell as a hoped-for pioneer, the dancing chauffeur routine, and does a step Russell taught him.
